name: implementation-plan-refiner
description: Refine an implementation plan against the issue brief for gaps and inconsistencies. Use after the first plan draft. Prefer questions over assumptions. Does not re-intake the issue or implement code.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of open questions; blocking items first.
